sources.origin: Tesla Q2 2026 production, deliveries and deployments

claims.claim: Actual Q2 deliveries of 480,126 materially exceeded the company-compiled analyst consensus average of 406,024 and median of 408,609 published before quarter end; energy storage deployments of 13.5 GWh were close to the 13.8 GWh average consensus.

risks: one-quarter delivery outperformance may include timing and inventory effects
company-compiled consensus is not company guidance and should not be treated as such
contradictions: Vehicle deliveries substantially beat compiled expectations while storage was roughly in line; execution strength was therefore uneven across operating vectors rather than uniformly above expectations.
unknowns: how much of the vehicle beat came from timing/incentives versus durable demand

recommendation.reason: Expectation comparison is directly source-addressed and explicitly distinguishes analyst consensus from company guidance.
